BiblicalUsage: Beth-Pazzez means house of dispersion, and it is named once, in Joshua 19:21, among the towns of Issachar — Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez. A town on a list, with a scattered name, and nothing more told about it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a town named for scattering had its place in the inheritance, and God did not lose track of it.
